title: Thai Trout with Briny Nam Prik
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai dish featuring pan-seared trout, served with a tangy and pungent nam prik sauce.
instructions: Season the trout fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the trout fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, heat the nam prik sauce in a separate pan over low heat.
Add the chopped Thai basil and prik nam pla to the nam prik sauce and stir to combine.
Serve the trout fillets with the nam prik sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional Thai basil, if desired.
